sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']>=20: out['frame']=n['boundary']
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and n['pixels']>=40 and n['boundary'][0][0]>20:
            out.setdefault('blocks',[]).append((n['color'],n['pixels']))
    return out
print("before", snap())
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':38,'col':31}])
print("after click bottom", snap(), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
